messages:
alex: Heads-up — we're seeing a sharp uptick in connection failures from edge sidecars in eu-west-1 starting ~08:20 UTC. App retries spiking, errors = "connect: cannot assign requested address". NAT GW metrics show active ports climbing fast.
mira: +1 saw 502s on streaming routes, a handful of model pulls failing with errno 99. Can you paste the netstat from a failing sidecar?
alex: netstat snapshot: `tcp 0 0 10.3.5.12:49152 52.95.23.11:443 TIME_WAIT` repeated tons. Also a bunch in `SYN_SENT` then drops.
sam: infra-bot posted alert: "natgw-port-utilization > 0.95 for nat-asset-eu1a" at 08:22. Looks like per-NAT ephemeral port ceiling.
ops-jen: Quick theory — connection churn from short-lived HTTPS-to-backend (model pulls + healthchecks) is exhausting ephemeral ports on NAT. Are we opening new outbound sockets per request?
mira: yes for model pull workers we don't reuse connections currently. We spawn many short-lived processes that hit external model hosts.
alex: dump of kernel errors on node: `cannot assign requested address` and `bind: address already in use` intermittently when sidecar tries to open new outbound.
sam: Immediate mitigation options: 1) route some egress through an egress-proxy in-cluster with connection pooling; 2) split egress across additional NAT Gateways (add per-AZ natgw and update route tables); 3) use NAT instances to spread ports; 4) enable HTTP/2 or keepalive to reduce ports. Thoughts on quick wins?
devex-liz: From app side, enabling keepalive + connection pool reuse should be straightforward (config toggle). We can flip for model pulls first.
ops-jen: I'll put a WIP runbook: increase NAT capacity by provisioning a second NAT GW in eu-west-1b and update the private subnet routes to round-robin. That should relieve immediate pressure while we roll app changes.
mira: Also worth bumping ephemeral port range on nodes (e.g., `sysctl net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range`) but that only delays the problem and doesn't solve central natgw limits.
alex: Agreed — node port range tweak as short-term stopgap. Longer term we should: instrument per-service egress port usage and add automatic egress-sharding by service.
sam: I'll create a small dashboard: NAT port utilization, distinct source IPs, and rate of new TCP ephemeral allocations per minute.
infra-bot: action created: #ticket 1379 "eu-west-1 NAT port exhaustion — provision extra natgw + app keepalive rollout" assigned to ops-jen, sam.
mira: Patch proposal: enable connection pooling for model-fetcher workers + reduce model-pull concurrency by 2x. I can PR today.
ops-jen: Rolling NAT GW change now (eu-west-1b). I'll monitor. ETA 30m. Adding a temporary IPtables SNAT rule on an instance is an option if needed.
alex: Thanks. Post any failing services here. If we still see errors after NAT add, we'll start shifting heavy egress to egress-proxy behind an NLB.
devex-liz: Note for docs — add guidance on ephemeral port limits and recommended app patterns (keepalive, pooling, backoff).
sam: Monitoring shows natgw active port util drop from 0.98 -> 0.45 after route change at 08:46 UTC. Errors dropping.
mira: Nice. Leaving this thread open for followups on app changes and dashboard.
alex: Follow-ups: 1) PR for keepalive (mira) 2) permanent egress architecture doc (liz) 3) dashboard + alert tuning (sam). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
